parts.technique: mean and variance from summary statistics (Sx, Sx2)

parts.label: b
parts.technique: coding to convert mean/sd to different units
parts.reason: S2.3 guidance explicitly includes understanding and use of coding.

parts.label: c(i)
parts.technique: effect on mean of adding data points
parts.reason: General reasoning about measures of central tendency, covered by S2.3.

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.technique: effect on standard deviation of adding data points
parts.reason: General reasoning about measures of variation, covered by S2.3.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.technique: interquartile range from box plot
parts.reason: S2.1/S2.3 cover interpercentile ranges and box plots.

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.technique: range from box plot
parts.reason: Measures of variation covered by S2.3, box plots by S2.1.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: skewness from quartiles/box plot
parts.reason: S2.1 covers interpreting box plots; skewness reasoning fits interpretation of diagrams.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: outlier identification and box plot redraw
parts.reason: S2.4 explicitly covers identifying outliers with a given rule (as specified here) and drawing box plots (S2.1).

parts.label: d
parts.technique: informal interpretation of a given correlation coefficient
parts.reason: S2.2 allows informal interpretation of correlation without calculation; no calculation of r required here, value is given.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: tree diagram completion
parts.reason: S3.1/S3.2 cover tree diagrams for probability.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: conditional probability, forming and solving equations
parts.reason: S3.2 covers conditional probability formula and use of tree diagrams to solve for unknowns.

parts.label: c(i)
parts.technique: conditional probability calculation
parts.reason: S3.2 covers conditional probability P(A|B) formula application.

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.technique: interpretation of usefulness of a test based on probability
parts.reason: Modelling/critiquing probability results, covered by S3.3 and use of conditional probability.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Normal distribution probability calculation
parts.reason: S4.2 covers finding probabilities using the Normal distribution via calculator.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: inverse Normal calculation
parts.reason: S4.2 covers use of Normal distribution including solving for boundary values (simultaneous equations context similarly covered).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: conditional probability with Normal distribution
parts.reason: Combines S3.2 conditional probability formula with S4.2 Normal probabilities, both in spec.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: binomial probability calculation
parts.reason: S4.1 covers calculating probabilities using the binomial distribution.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: E(X) of a discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicit exclusion: calculation of mean of discrete random variables is excluded.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Var(X) of a discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicit exclusion: calculation of variance of discrete random variables is excluded.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: find q from probabilities summing to 1, using p from (b)
parts.reason: Depends on the out-of-spec value of p found in part (b) (excluded variance calculation), so this part only makes sense after an out-of-spec part.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: probability of winning game using p and q values
parts.reason: Requires numeric values of p and q derived from the excluded mean/variance calculations in (b) and (c); depends on out-of-spec parts.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: comparing E(X) and P(win) to judge decision
parts.reason: Depends directly on E(X) from (a) and P(win) from (d), both out-of-spec/derived from out-of-spec parts.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: calculation of product moment correlation coefficient from summary statistics
parts.reason: S5.1 explicit exclusion: calculation of correlation coefficients is excluded; this overrides the calculator-use allowance since the task is presented as a formula-based calculation from summary statistics.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: interpretation of a calculated correlation coefficient
parts.reason: Depends directly on the out-of-spec calculated value in part (a).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: informal judgement of linear relationship from scatter diagram
parts.reason: S2.2 allows informal interpretation of correlation from a scatter diagram (points close to a line) without requiring the calculated r value, so full marks achievable without the out-of-spec part.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: finding regression line equation y=a+bx
parts.reason: S2.2 explicit exclusion: calculations involving regression lines are excluded.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: interpretation of regression gradient
parts.reason: Depends on the out-of-spec regression line calculation in (d).

parts.label: f
parts.technique: drawing regression line on scatter diagram
parts.reason: Depends directly on the out-of-spec regression equation found in (d).

parts.label: g
parts.technique: identify point relative to regression line for targeting
parts.reason: Requires reference to the regression line's position (above/below average) which depends on the out-of-spec regression calculation.
